rule_hits: secrets: new Secret contract, secretKeyRef wiring for DB/MQ credentials, JWT/queue-token/QR/PII keys; dev Secret values generated from a committed dev-only env file

permissions: pod/container securityContext, Pod Security Admission namespace labels, automountServiceAccountToken, NetworkPolicy (default-deny + allow matrix) that decides which pod may call which service
protected paths: .github/workflows/ci.yml (validate-deploy step) and .github/scripts/gates.sh (C4.4) must change, otherwise the kustomize layout breaks the existing kubeconform step
runtime identity change in images: deploy/docker/*.Dockerfile USER nonroot:nonroot / USER worker -> numeric uid (affects compose and every image)
new CI tool images (registry.k8s.io/kubectl, mikefarah/yq) = dependency change
llm_assessment: high-risk (agrees with rules; config/infra alone would be standard, but secrets + permissions + protected CI paths raise it; cannot lower)
consequences: human approves spec.md (incl. decisions D1-D6 in spec section 8) before implementation
plan review mandatory (clean context, spec + plan only, max 3 rounds)
test design by a separate agent with RED check: policy fixtures and validate tests exist and fail before deploy/k8s/policy/check_policy.py exists
correctness + security review and a challenge on a different model; every finding needs a repro command
mutation test on the policy script (each rule disabled in turn must make the self-test fail) + rollback check
human sign-off before merge to develop
